The implementation of the `ImmutableFsPermission` class provides the necessary functionality to support this feature, ensuring that the new immutable permissions behave correctly by preventing modifications through overridden methods. Thus, the documentation and the code changes are closely related, with the code providing the functionality that is being documented.
